faqs.q: What is bariatric surgery for weight loss?
faqs.a: Bariatric surgery is a life-transforming procedure aimed at helping patients reach dramatic, long-lasting weight loss. Bariatric surgery is mainly based on limiting your food intake as well as nutrient absorption. It is not a cosmetic procedure but a highly helpful treatment aimed at solving serious co-morbidities, such as Type 2 Diabetes, high blood pressure, etc.

faqs.q: How much weight loss can you expect after bariatric surgery?
faqs.a:
Weight loss after bariatric surgery varies from patient to patient. Most individuals lose a significant percentage of their excess body weight over 12 to 18 months when they follow medical advice, dietary guidance, and follow-up care.
Long-term success depends on commitment to lifestyle changes and regular monitoring.

faqs.q: What is the average cost of bariatric surgery in Ahmedabad?
faqs.a:
The cost of bariatric surgery might vary depending on the type of surgery that is going to be performed (for instance, sleeve gastrectomy vs. bypass), the hospital stay, and other tests that might be required. We put together a comprehensive package cost that includes specifics after your consulting session with us.
Additionally, we facilitate paperwork, such as benefits for PMJAY, to make it easy to identify that quality treatment is available at Silver Touch Hospitals.
